conventions.coordinates: K/M labels stand for completed accepted ledger checkpoints, not actual head hashes. Each fixture has its own history.
conventions.intervals: Start included, end excluded. null end means no known end in that account, never unknown start or certain eternity.
conventions.cells: Logical applicability versions, not a choice of nodes, property storage or public identifiers.
conventions.outputs: Hand-authored expectations, not observations. Outcome labels are draft test vocabulary, not shipped enums.
conventions.knowledge: Every historical output, including interval metadata and evidence, is bounded by its selected prefix.

source_statements.meaning: Original report: price is 750 cents from 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z; no end is stated.
Actual transition: price becomes 800 cents at 2026-05-12T00:00:00Z, ending the prior price period.
Correction of the ended period: price from 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z until 2026-05-12T00:00:00Z was 775 cents, not 750. No new world transition.
Synthetic inspection reports diameter 12000 micrometres. Observation and applicability time are not stated.
Corrigendum corrects that inspection report to 12200 micrometres. It supplies no date and asserts no physical change.
